description: What the task thinking-effort suite must notice: the provider ignores the setting of a task or takes auto for nothing, decides on the level of the connection, remembers a refusal under the wrong level; the runner neither keeps the setting nor hands it to the provider, accepts a word that is not a level, or forgets it in a follow-up; the task does not show it.

mutations.name: T1
mutations.what: the provider ignores the setting of the task

patches.old: const effort = reasoningEffort === undefined || reasoningEffort === null ? null : parseReasoningEffort(reasoningEffort) ?? null;

mutations.name: T2
mutations.what: auto, asked by a task, is taken for "follow the connection"

mutations.name: T3
mutations.what: the request is decided on the level of the connection, whoever asked

mutations.name: T4
mutations.what: a refusal is remembered under the level of the connection, not the level that was refused

patches.old: const key = decision.send ? { endpoint, model: this.model, effort } : null;
patches.new: const key = decision.send ? { endpoint, model: this.model, effort: this.reasoningEffort } : null;

mutations.name: T5
mutations.what: the task does not keep the setting it was given

mutations.name: T6
mutations.what: the runner does not hand the setting of the task to the provider

mutations.name: T7
mutations.what: a word that is not a level is accepted

mutations.name: T8
mutations.what: a follow-up forgets the setting it is given

mutations.name: T9
mutations.what: the task does not show its setting
